predecessor_policy: Keep protocols 1–4 and every earlier report unchanged. Unfiltered v5 includes every v4 startup and HTTP workload with identical settings, plus only the status-renderer variants below. Never pool protocol versions or infer a passing complete workload from a selected run.

new_workload.runtime_substitutions: Before each process launch and outside its timed interval, replace template pid with the live driver PID and heartbeat_at with the current Unix millisecond timestamp. Keep all other snapshot bytes and the stdin fixture identical between Node and native. The live PID and fresh heartbeat make the renderer exercise the online session state rather than its offline fallback.
new_workload.file_policy: Stage stdin and the status snapshot in a fresh private scratch directory, set AUTOROUTER_STATUS_FILE only for this workload, and remove both on completion or failure. Do not retain absolute paths, PID, heartbeat, raw private input, process environment or status file contents in report rows; retain declared template/input SHA-256 and the exact output SHA-256.
new_workload.ordering_and_samples: Five paired alternating Node/native rounds; per width and engine, ten untimed warmups and one hundred measured complete process launches. Deterministic --validate uses one round, one warmup and two measured launches. Clock starts immediately before spawn and ends after successful child exit, as in v4. No stdin writer or status-file update occurs inside the timed interval.
new_workload.verification: For every launch require success, empty stderr and bounded stdout. Within each width and engine, require an identical output hash across warmup and measured launches. Between Node and native, require identical output bytes, not merely a matching hash. Require a meaningful online Sonnet/Jev line with the declared context and savings at widths where they fit; every output must obey its declared terminal width. Retain one output hash and width per comparison, with no status text or raw session data in routine diagnostics.
new_workload.selection: --workload startup_status_snapshot selects all four widths and no HTTP or other startup cases. It skips the inherited gateway-only descriptor preflight and collector because it launches no gateway, and rejects a selected descriptor collector. This selection is available on a 16 GiB host and explicitly marks every excluded inherited workload unmeasured. A full unfiltered v5 still requires the inherited v4 near-limit 32 GiB capacity and 1,024-file-descriptor preflights and all inherited concurrency groups.
new_workload.acceptance: The frozen startup ratio maximum remains 0.5 and representative-hardware qualification remains false on an uncontrolled normal-use workstation. These are warm filesystem/OS-cache runs, not cold reboot/cache-purge or npm dispatcher measurements. This addition supplies status-renderer input/snapshot/width coverage only; no provider, evaluator, model download, release qualification or overall performance claim follows.
